rows.title: Self-contained release bundle
rows.text: The distributable carries every runtime dependency and completes its smoke check without contacting any remote service.

rows.title: Approval recovery procedure
rows.text: A denied command can be requested again with a fresh authorization; the previous denial never grants lasting permission.

rows.title: Repository index invalidation
rows.text: When tracked content changes, discard the old generation and publish a freshly built repository snapshot before serving reads.

rows.title: Use-time provenance verification
rows.text: A recalled item is advisory until its canonical source is fetched again and confirmed available at the moment of use.

rows.title: Intermittent verification diagnosis
rows.text: Reproduce the nondeterministic check repeatedly, isolate shared state, and never label a flaky run as a deterministic product failure.

rows.title: Retrieval feature rollback
rows.text: Keep the semantic branch behind a disabled-by-default switch so operators can return immediately to lexical lookup.

rows.title: 离线发布归档
rows.text: 最终可分发构建保存在本地发布归档中，并且附带完整性校验值。

rows.title: 个人偏好记忆决定
rows.text: 先前决定仅保存用户明确要求记住的偏好，并允许用户查看和撤回。

rows.title: Event stream continuation
rows.text: After transport loss, reconnect with the last acknowledged cursor and request only events that follow it.

rows.title: Recoverable storage cleanup
rows.text: Measure the exact targets first and move removable artifacts to a recoverable location before permanent deletion.

rows.title: Crash-safe schema evolution
rows.text: Write the migrated state beside the old state, validate it fully, then switch the pointer atomically while retaining rollback metadata.

rows.title: Schedule timezone identity
rows.text: Persist the named timezone and local wall-clock intent, then derive each execution instant with daylight-saving rules.

rows.title: 工具调用审计链
rows.text: 每次工具动作都绑定触发消息、授权决定、参数摘要和不可变结果标识。

rows.title: Workspace continuation marker
rows.text: Persist the last durable plan revision and reopen from that marker instead of replaying completed effects.

rows.title: Dependency resolution identity
rows.text: Treat the exact lockfile plus package-manager version and artifact hashes as the reproducible dependency identity.

rows.title: Execution recovery checkpoint
rows.text: Resume from the last committed effect boundary and revalidate external state before performing the next mutation.
